notes.title: Free DLC/Content Update (v 1.4) Out Now + Patreon Launch!
notes.notes:
[b]Rise and shine, Dwellers![/b]

[b]Version 1.4[/b] is finally upon you, with a host of exciting new features included:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617228/c0588ed7df0c25a288b19a28c53f2ce6ba551783.png[/img]

Your continued support means the world to us, and we hope you'll enjoy this free update which closes out part 1 of our story. [b]It wouldn't have been possible without you![/b]

[b]Pitstop in Purgatory[/b] is currently 50% off as part of Steam's [b]Spring Sale[/b] (running to Mar 23, 10 AM Pacific), so the timing couldn't be better to visit Purgatory for the first time. [b]Spread the word! :)[/b]

In addition, we've launched an official [url=https://www.patreon.com/Tymedust]Patreon[/url]! Using this platform, you can support us, help make the scope of our games larger, and earn cool rewards. [b]Everything[/b] we earn on there goes toward game development!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617228/7b6d829e2244e5ceb3513b8edb6dff101d8e6abb.png[/img]

[i]Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for playing our games and enjoying them. You make us feel like there's a place in the world for our unique vision, and we appreciate you all so, so much for that![/i]

[b][i]Have a Guide-tastic weekend![/i][/b]

/The Team

notes.title: Android Release + DLC News
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

Just popping in to tell y'all that [b]Pitstop in Purgatory[/b] is finally available on Android! This is our first mobile release and as such we're really proud of it, and so thankful for your continued support. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617228/2aeea87a928137465b39f650e11aa41b82a89030.png[/img]

You can check it out in the [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tymedustgames.pitstopinpurgatory]Google Play Store[/url] with the [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tymedustgames.pitstopinpurgatorydemo]demo version also available there[/url], or as always [url=https://tymedust.itch.io/pitstop-in-purgatory]on itch.io[/url].

Also, we'd like to share that we're aiming for the game's [b]free DLC[/b] to release in [b]March[/b]!

The DLC will provide closure to part 1 of our story, setting the stage for the game's sequel while also allowing you to hang out with the cast one last time. [i]We hope you're looking forward to it![/i]

Pitstop in Purgatory is a game that you haven't truly completed until you've played all routes, so we strongly recommend doing so before trying the DLC.

[b]Thanks for reading and have an awesome week! :)[/b]

/Tymedust Games

notes.title: Game Release!
notes.notes:
[b]Pitstop in Purgatory[/b], the acclaimed visual novel/graphic adventure game, is finally on Steam!

Soundtrack and deluxe edition bundle also available.

Thank you so much to everyone who's followed the game's development and added it to their wishlists.

[i]You mean the world to us![/i]

[b]Enjoy your stay in Purgatory![/b]
